project_type: Serverless AWS platform (AI-DLC methodology-as-data). Node.js ESM Lambdas (npm workspaces) + React/Vite frontend + Terraform IaC. This task touches only the Node Lambda layer.
language: JavaScript (ESM, Node 24 target). No TypeScript in the lambda layer.
build_system: npm workspaces at repo root. Per-lambda build via esbuild (e.g. `npm run build -w seed-blocks`). Terraform builds/zips each lambda on deploy; terraform binary is NOT installed in this sandbox, so validate at unit-test level only.
test_framework: vitest with per-lambda projects auto-discovered from lambda/*/test/. Run a single project with `npx vitest run --project=seed-blocks` (also workflows, building-blocks). Note: vitest.config.js has globalSetup that spins up DynamoDB Local + Gremlin testcontainers via docker; if docker is unavailable the seed-blocks/workflows/building-blocks suites still run because they mock AWS SDK with aws-sdk-client-mock, but the global testcontainer setup may fail to start. Prefer `npx vitest run --project=seed-blocks` and report if global setup blocks it; a fallback is running the pure mapper/unit assertions.
build_command: npm run build -w seed-blocks (esbuild bundle; validates the lambda bundles cleanly)
verification_instructions: 1) `npm run build -w seed-blocks` bundles without error. 2) `npx vitest run --project=seed-blocks` passes (existing aidlc-v2 tests + new bmad tests). 3) `npm run lint` (oxlint) and `npm run format:check` (oxfmt) are clean on touched files. 4) Author-time data validation: every authored bmad block must pass shared/blocks.js validateBlockInput/validateId and the workflow must pass shared/workflows.js validateId/validatePhaseNode — assert this in a unit test that feeds the authored dataset through buildFromFiles/the bmad builder and then validates each produced block.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. The seed writes to DynamoDB + S3 at deploy time via the seed-blocks Lambda; there are no committed generated fixtures. The BMAD dataset authored in this task IS committed source (markdown), not generated.
setup_instructions: From repo root: `npm install` (installs root + workspace deps incl. vitest, aws-sdk-client-mock, js-yaml, tar-stream). No frontend install needed for this task.
environment_constraints: Terraform binary NOT installed — cannot run terraform fmt/validate or deploy; validate only at data/unit-test level. Docker MAY be unavailable — vitest globalSetup (DynamoDB Local + Gremlin testcontainers) could fail to start; the seed-blocks/workflows/building-blocks suites themselves mock AWS via aws-sdk-client-mock and do not need real AWS. GitHub reachable via authenticated gateway. Work happens on a NEW branch off `main` (default branch confirmed via gh api = main), NOT on the currently-checked-out fix/yjs-prebuilt-image branch (whose prior commits must be preserved).
contribution_requirements: kebab-case ids everywhere (enforced by ID_RE in shared/blocks.js and shared/workflows.js). oxlint + oxfmt clean (CI enforces `npm run format:check`). vitest unit tests on Node 22+24 in CI. Pre-commit hook runs oxfmt/oxlint/secretlint/vitest --changed. Do NOT push or open PR (orchestrator does that). Commit locally on the feature branch.
key_patterns: SEED FLOW: lambda/seed-blocks/index.js calls fetchCoreFiles(ref) (shared/repo-fetch.js) to pull awslabs/aidlc-workflows core/** tarball, then buildFromFiles(files) (shared/block-mappers.js) maps markdown+frontmatter into blocks and derives the single `aidlc-v2` SYSTEM workflow, then writes BLOCK#SYSTEM#<TYPE>#<id> (V#latest + V#1) and WF#SYSTEM#aidlc-v2 partitions to DynamoDB with bodies externalized to S3. BLOCK SHAPES: mapStage/mapAgent/mapScope/mapRule/mapSensor/mapKnowledge/mapSkill/mapTemplate in block-mappers.js define exact field shapes; validation lives in shared/blocks.js (validateBlockInput per type, validateId kebab-case). WORKFLOW SHAPE: buildDefaultWorkflow() produces {id,name,objective,defaultScope,phases[],placements[],ruleRefs[],scopeRefs[]}; buildWorkflowItems() in seed-blocks/index.js turns that into META+PHASE+PLACEMENT+RULEREF+SCOPEREF rows + V#1 snapshots. PLACEMENTS carry scopeMembership map {scopeId: EXECUTE|SKIP}; order must be a topological linearization (topologicalStageOrder). PHASE_ORDER = [initialization, ideation, inception, construction, operation]; phasePath = 2-digit index. SYSTEM tenant = 'SYSTEM' (shared/tenant.js). WORKFLOWS CRUD (lambda/workflows/index.js): listWorkflows queries GSI1 TENANT#SYSTEM#WORKFLOW so a SECOND SYSTEM workflow appears automatically; SYSTEM workflows are read-only through the API (create/update/delete return 403); reads fall back to SYSTEM. So seeding WF#SYSTEM#bmad as a parallel SYSTEM partition is exactly the right seam — it lists next to aidlc-v2 and is read-only, matching the intent. DESIGN CHOICE for shipping bmad WITH THE FORK: author a fork-local dataset (markdown files mirroring upstream core/** frontmatter) committed under lambda/seed-blocks/bmad/, load it inside the seed handler (bundled via esbuild/import, no network needed), map it through the same mappers, build a bmad workflow (own builder, NOT buildDefaultWorkflow's hardcoded aidlc-v2 id), and write it as a second SYSTEM workflow. All bmad block ids are namespaced `bmad-*` so they never collide with or shadow the upstream `aidlc-*` SYSTEM ids.
